llms.body:
# Autotrader

> Autotrader (autotrader.com) is a US online automotive marketplace, launched in 1997 and part of Cox Automotive. It lists roughly 2 million new, used, and certified pre-owned vehicles from franchise dealers, independent dealers, and private sellers, and pairs that inventory with pricing tools, payment calculators, model research, and buying advice.

How to use this site:

- **Two parallel URL families, and they are not interchangeable.** `/<make>` and `/<body-style>` are stable *research* hubs (model lineups, buying tips, pricing overviews). `/cars-for-sale/...` is *live inventory search*. Use the research hubs for durable facts and the inventory paths for what is currently listed.
- **Inventory results are transient and location-dependent.** Listing counts, prices, and the vehicles themselves change daily, and results are geo-filtered by the requester's inferred location. Never present a count or price from an inventory page as a stable fact, and note that results are local unless a city is specified in the URL.
- **Inventory URLs are composable.** Facets stack as path segments in any combination:

      /cars-for-sale/<condition>       used-cars | new-cars | certified-cars | by-owner | all-cars
      /cars-for-sale/<year>            1983 through 2026
      /cars-for-sale/<make>/<model>/<trim>
      /cars-for-sale/<body-style>      sedan | coupe | convertible | hatchback | wagon |
                                       suv-crossover | truck | van-minivan
      /cars-for-sale/<fuel>            electric | hybrid | plug-in-hybrid | diesel | hydrogen
